name: tradew
description: TradeW monorepo — trading platform, AI foundation (ai-core), and premium intelligence products

scripts.//postinstall: @tradew/types, @tradew/ai-core and @tradew/market-data are consumed by their built `main`/`types` (dist/), never their source, and dist/ is gitignored. So a clean checkout resolves none of them: every CI job failed with TS2307 'Cannot find module @tradew/types', and the test job additionally failed with vite's 'Failed to resolve entry for package @tradew/ai-core'. ci.yml built two of the three, but only in the typecheck job — each job gets a fresh runner, so the test job never saw them. @tradew/database joined this list on 2026-08-20: it now ships runtime code (src/credential-crypto.ts, the at-rest format for broker credentials) consumed by services/api and services/market-data through its built `main`, so it has the same clean-checkout problem as the other three. Done here, in dependency order, rather than as per-package `prepare` hooks: npm runs those concurrently, so market-data's build started before types had emitted and died on the very error this exists to prevent.
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @tradew/types && npm run build -w @tradew/database && npm run build -w @tradew/ai-core && npm run build -w @tradew/market-data
scripts.//dev:reset: Recovery for Next's `Cannot find module './NNN.js'` — a desynced dev cache in apps/web or apps/admin, which 500s every route including /login. Stop the dev servers first, run this, start them again. See scripts/dev-reset-next.mjs for why it happens and why there is no code fix.
scripts.//preflight: Config/connectivity check for the faults that otherwise surface as an unexplained HTTP 500 on every /api/* call: no root .env (so services/api exits before binding :4000 and Next's proxy answers ECONNREFUSED as a bare 500), missing JWT_SECRET/DATABASE_URL, or an unreachable Postgres. Runs automatically before dev:api via predev:api; run it directly with `npm run preflight` to diagnose a dead backend.
